discoveries.title: 2 ma tra ve BAR0 chua biet: 0xBAD00100 va 0xFFFFFFFF
discoveries.detail: Doc lai 16 vung 'DATA' trong aperture map, dem distinct u32. 0x010000..0x01FFFF (16 trang) va 0x058000..0x060FFF (9 trang) chi chua 0xBAD00100 lap vo han; 16 trang dau giong het nhau. 0x0A0000..0x0BFFFF (32) va 0x3D8000..0x3FFFFF (40) chi chua 0xFFFFFFFF.

discoveries.title: BAR3 (32 MB) decode duoc — bang page-directory + tra cuu device ID
discoveries.detail: Doc 32 MB BAR3 qua PCI resource, 130/8192 trang nong. Vung 0x17000..0x27000 va 0x30000..: entry 16 B {u32 addr buoc +0x20000, u32 flags 0x06000000, 8 B zero}. Vung 0x2b000: 496 entry 8 B {tag 0x1F4C1001..0x1F4DFF01 buoc +0x100, flags 0x06000000}. Vung 0x16000: 45 entry device ID (0x1F4F x43, 0x1F4E x2) — KHONG co 0x1F0B.

discoveries.title: BAR1 (64 GB) KHONG decode qua PCI resource raw
discoveries.detail: Quet 24 offset rai rac trong 8 GB BAR1 + BAR3 doi chieu. BAR1 tra ve 0/4096 o moi offset -> can driver lap trinh aperture (NV_PBUS_BAR1_BLOCK=0x801F7CC0). Doc VRAM/WPR2 tu host can GHI register -> BLOCKED, khong phai 'WPR chan doc'.

discoveries.title: BAR3 du lieu THAT — da xac nhan REDACTED_USER on dinh (skill pitfall bus float)
discoveries.detail: Doc BAR3 0x17000 va 0x2b000 3 lan cach 200 ms: giong het byte. Xen ke BAR3 -> BAR0 0x300000 -> BAR3: khong doi. Positive control BAR0 co 3617/4096 nonzero -> duong doc song. BAR1 3 lan x 3 offset: 0/1024 o ca 3 lan va on dinh -> that su khong decode, khong phai chua san sang.

discoveries.title: U-SEC-001 RESOLVED — loi gan nhan, khong co mau thuan WPR
discoveries.detail: Tra source driver 615.78.08 (52 register turing): chi co DUNG 2 register WPR, NV_PFB_PRI_MMU_WPR2_ADDR_LO=0x1FA824 va NV_PFB_PRI_MMU_WPR2_ADDR_HI=0x1FA828. Khong co register nao o 0x1FA820. p8_wpr.py gan nhan sai 0x1FA820 la 'WPR2_LO'. Cap 0x1FA824/0x1FA828 khớp chinh xac dmesg 'WPR=01ffee00:01f7e000'. WPR2 that su = 0x01F7E000..0x01FFEE00 = 457.0 MiB, khong phai 23.75 KB. Da xoa 4 vung WPR0/WPR1/WPR2/WPR2-alt gia khoi 3 file bao cao.
